plans.objective: Make T_dev (selected assert_* tests) fail on /workspace/buggy and pass on /workspace/fixed by adjusting only environments E_B and E_F (build/deps/runtime), without editing T_dev.
assumptions: The two checkouts (/workspace/buggy and /workspace/fixed) correspond to buggy vs fixed pandas builds, but current E_B/E_F are such that the selected test does not transition as required; a rebuild with era-pinned dependency versions (especially NumPy) can flip the failure/passing behavior by changing float64 rounding/typedefs used in the Cython extension path.

actions.step: Check interpreter version in each checkout (no assumptions about harness CPython; only for sanity).

Re-run only the same selected failing case on fixed to confirm it PASSes.
